st_off: Chat reading is turned off in Settings: nothing is read.
st_no_bridge: The Home Assistant module is missing: without it nothing can start at your place. You can still write your rules and read the log. To only show on-screen alerts, tick “Read the chat even without Home Assistant” in the settings.
st_no_api: The site's YouTube key is missing: without it the chat cannot be read.
st_no_channel: The “YouTube channel” module is missing (with your channel's id): it is what tells when you are live.
st_ambiguous: You have several YouTube channels: choose the one to read in the Settings tab.
st_unverified: I cannot check your YouTube channel right now. I keep trying by myself while the page is open.
st_budget: Paused: the share of YouTube's limit planned for today ({percent}%) is used up. Reading resumes {when}.
st_no_chat: Your live {title} has no chat: there is nothing to read.
st_idle: No YouTube live right now. I check again every minute while this page stays open.
st_reading: I am reading the chat of your live {title}. Last read: {when}.
err_config: The site's YouTube key is missing: add it in the “YouTube connector” module.
err_unavailable: The “YouTube connector” module is missing: it holds the site's YouTube key.
err_auth: YouTube refuses the site's key. Check it in the “YouTube connector” module. Next try {when}.
err_chat_denied: Connect your YouTube account in the YouTube connector: YouTube does not let this chat be read with the site's key alone.
err_quota: YouTube's daily limit is reached. Reading resumes {when}.
err_rate: YouTube asks for a pause. Next try {when}.
err_timeout: YouTube is not answering. Next try {when}.
err_network: YouTube is not answering. Next try {when}.
err_channel: Your channel's id is not filled in in the “YouTube channel” module (it starts with UC).
err_invalid: The site's YouTube connector is too old to read a chat: please update it.
house_none: The Home Assistant module is not installed: nothing can play at your place. Here you can only write rules and read the log.
house_unknown: I cannot read the state of Home Assistant right now.
house_unpaired: Home Assistant is not paired yet: open the Home Assistant module's page (“pair” step).
house_cut: Everything is cut: nothing plays at your place, even when a donation arrives.
house_offline: Home Assistant no longer answers at your place: donations will be refused until it is back.
house_not_live: Home Assistant does not see you live (it relies on Twitch to know): YouTube donations will be refused until it does.
house_ok: Home Assistant is connected and sees you live.
big_no_right: You are not allowed to cut everything from this page: ask the person who manages the site.
big_resume_no_right: Everything is cut. Only someone who can edit the rules can resume.
suggest_bridge: sends orders to Home Assistant (lights, message read aloud)
suggest_api: keeps the site's YouTube key and reads the chat
suggest_channel: tells whether your YouTube channel is live
info_open: **Keep this page open during your live.** The chat is only read while it is open (on this computer or another device). Page closed: nothing is read any more, neither donations nor “!stop”.
info_stop: “!stop” and “!start” written in the chat only work while reading. Your real protections are the big “Cut everything” button and the switch in Home Assistant. YouTube moderators may cut (adjustable); only the channel owner can resume. This module does not answer in the chat: the site's key can only read it.
info_gift: A donation cannot be refunded. If Home Assistant refuses the action (everything is cut, you are not live, the message is refused…), it is not played and the reason is written in the log.
info_currency: YouTube gives no exchange rate: a minimum only makes sense in a single currency. A rule “at least 5 EUR” does not fire for a donation in dollars. Choose “All currencies” to accept any amount, or create one rule per currency.
info_nochat: A live with its chat turned off cannot be read. A private or unlisted live is not seen with the site's key.
rules_empty: No rule yet. A rule says: when this donation arrives, play this action. Add one below, for example “Super Chat of 5 € or more → lumieres:rouge”.
rules_full: You already have {max} rules: delete one to add another.
f_name_help: To find it again, for example “Red for big donations” (64 characters at most).
f_type_help: The kind of support that fires the rule.
f_currency_help: The minimum is compared in this currency, without conversion. “All currencies”: any amount, no minimum.
f_min: Minimum amount (or number of gifted memberships)
f_min_help: For example 5 or 2.50. For gifted memberships: the minimum number, for example 5. No effect for a new membership, nor when the currency is “all”.
f_cooldown_help: Minimum time between two firings of this rule, for example 30. Use 0 for no delay.
f_action_help: The name of the action linked in Home Assistant. This module knows neither your lights nor your scenes: only this name.
f_custom_action_help: Only if the name is not in the list: lowercase letters, digits, “:”, “-” and “_”. For example: lumieres:violet
f_read: Read the Super Chat message aloud
f_read_help: For a voice action (tts:…). Home Assistant checks the text first: refused words, links… Without this box, the voice only says the thank-you.
err_name: Give the rule a name, for example “Red for big donations”.
err_type: Choose a kind of support from the list.
err_currency: Choose a currency from the list, for example EUR.
err_count: Write a number between 1 and 1000, for example 5.
err_cooldown: Write a number of seconds between 0 and 3600, for example 30.
err_action: Write a name like lumieres:rouge (lowercase letters, digits, “:”, “-” and “_”, 40 characters at most).
err_house_absent: Home Assistant does not answer: nothing changed.
sim_help: Try your rules without waiting for a real donation. The simulation follows the same path as a real one but **asks YouTube nothing**. Careful: if Home Assistant is open (paired, not cut, and it sees you live), the action really plays at your place.
sim_no_bridge: The Home Assistant module is needed to simulate a donation.
sim_amount_help: For example 5 or 2.50 (Super Chat and Super Sticker).
sim_text_help: Optional. If there is a voice rule, Home Assistant checks the text before reading it.
sim_err_too_fast: A little patience: one simulation every 3 seconds.
sim_err_too_many: Already 30 simulations this hour: try again later.
sim_err_no_bridge: The Home Assistant module is not installed.
sim_err_bad_type: Choose a kind from the list.
sim_err_bad_currency: Choose a currency from the list, for example EUR.
sim_err_bad_count: Write a number between 1 and 1000, for example 5.
sim_err_other: The simulation could not start. Try again.
jr_empty: Nothing yet. Donations received and simulations show up here.
jr_note: 50 events at most. The text of messages is never kept.
ev_old: {count} donation(s) ignored as too old: they date from before this page was opened.
res_failed: Home Assistant could not play it
res_ignored_unmapped: Home Assistant has no action linked to this name
res_ignored_expired: Arrived too late at Home Assistant
res_refused_off: Everything is cut: nothing is played
res_refused_offline: Home Assistant does not answer: nothing is played
res_refused_not_live: Home Assistant does not see you live: nothing is played
res_refused_blocked: The message is refused by the text check: nothing is played
res_refused_busy: Home Assistant is busy: nothing is played
res_refused_unknown_key: Invalid action name: nothing is played
res_refused_not_paired: Home Assistant is not paired: nothing is played
res_refused_not_installed: The Home Assistant module is not installed: nothing is played
res_cmd_refused: {command} refused: only the channel owner (or a moderator, for !stop) can give it
limit_text: Today this module used about {used}% of your YouTube daily limit (it stops gently at {max}%). Reading a live chat costs about {hour}% per hour; looking for a live, almost nothing.
reload_note: This page reloads by itself while it is open: that is what lets the chat be read.
st_connect: Connect your YouTube account in the YouTube connector: YouTube does not let this chat be read with the site's key alone.
res_alert_only: Shown as an alert only (no Home Assistant)
